spans.text: The followers of Vestias are a curious clergy - though they draw divine spells from Vestias, their connection to the nádislin goddess grants them access to the innate powers of a sorcerer as well. Clerics and paladins often use their faith and adherence to gain their magical powers, but for these devotees it is their acceptance of Vestias’ dogma and their shared thirst for knowledge and freedom that empowers their spells. Among the Clergy of the Four, there is more of an evil disposition among the Spellborne than the other clergies, and it is entirely possible that members of Vestias’ faithful may oppose one another: one may seek to claim forbidden knowledge for selfish purposes, while another may stand against them to prevent the abuse of that ancient knowledge; both could fall under Vestias’ favor.

Her clergy members who act in the name of moderation and goodness often share the favorable label of “the Resplendent”, whereas those who follow her for evil purposes are branded with the title of “Spawn of Vestias”. Categorically, the majority of Vestias’ Spellborne Clergy are evil, and sects often form and operate in cult-like factions. Some believe that such cults share countersigns and coded cant to disguise their interactions. More interestingly, it is a widely held belief that a cabal of Vestian clerics run a secret council that influences Retia’s future from behind the scenes.
